title: I bought my kitten meat today and it was really showing me his various skills
author: KingHumour17
text: I bought my kitten meat today and it was really showing me his various skills and talents just to get the meat  🫣
blurb: Their human bought the kitten some meat, and the tiny black kitten put on a whole show of skills and talents just to earn a bite. Here the hopeful little one looks up at the skewers, mouth open, ready for the prize.
